no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it takes its input and keeps only its own rows (ai, ai-job) in your own store (its records come in as input.records, its writes go back as keep).
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Show me my AIs and computers: which are live now, what each can do and how many jobs each is doing", and give it nothing more: every input is optional.
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:see-my-ais and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Reads the person's ai records and counts the ai-job records each AI holds as taker.

4. It reads no store itself: the ai and ai-job records it needs (and, for a finish, the consumer record the saved acceptance names) are read by your AI from your own store and handed in as input.records; the writes it makes come back as keep for your AI to apply to that store, each one only if the record is still as it was read.
